title: Toddler Time Management - Timer Tips for Parents
description:
🎙️ COMING SOON — Episode 7 of the Working Moms Podcast

Struggling with bedtime routines or clean-up time? This simple tool can make all the difference — a timer!

In this clip from our upcoming episode, Child Development Expert Mary Sue Watson shares one of her favorite parenting hacks: teaching time awareness through gentle structure and consistency, starting when kids are very young.

✨ Why it works:
✅ Gives children a clear expectation
✅ Helps build trust and predictability
✅ Teaches early time management skills
